nom: OLEHENRIKSEN Silkfoliant Daily Tri-Acid Smoothing Toner with Mandelic Acid

avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This toner is alright. It has exfoliating properties and it helps my skin smoother a bit. Because of the exfoliating chemicals, sunscreen is a must to protect my facial skin. With the price point, I rather invest in serum products. The packaging is simple, easy to dispense the toner on hands or cotton pads.

It has a slight refreshing fragrance that smells light. I've been super sick in the last week and one of the products that i have been using to keep my skin from looking as dry as the sahara has been this product. It doesn't irritate my skin at all and my skin just drinks it up. My skin always feel more plump whenever i use this.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I used this product one time. The following morning I had a rash on my face. Unfortunately it's not for me. I have sensitive skin but never know what bothers me until I try it.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love this brand. Everything from the packaging to the results is spot on. The scent of this toner, the way it absorbs into my skin and the way it feels on my face is so lovely. I highly recommend. I've been seeing results after only a week of using it! Ole Henriksen toners work great & are always worth the price!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love this toner. It went on really smoothly and made my skin feel very refreshed. Highly recommend ingredients not sure about but the sun was nice. ￼

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This toner is amazing if you have combination or oily skin. It helped clear some breakout that i had. It does have a little sting when applying but it's not to bad. It helped keep my face oil free longer than expected.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The product has tightened my skin and brings cleanliness to my face. It doesn't burn or hurt. I would recommend this product for anyone interested.

avis.titre: Great aside toner for acne prone, sensitive skin

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I've been using this toner for about a month now, about 2-3 times a week, and I've really been enjoying it so far. I wanted to mention that so it doesn't give the wrong impression! I'm definitely planning to keep using it to see how my skin continues to respond. avis.titre: An extraordinary change in my skin texture
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This exfoliating toner is amazing! It really helped transform my skin's texture and tone. My pores, blemishes, and imperfections improved and were minimized -I'd say by about 60%. It has a very subtle clean scent, and honestly, I was a little worried knowing I had to be extra careful in the sun. But using it at night made me feel much more at ease. I was very careful because of the instructions that it could cause a reaction on my skin, but honestly, it was gentle on me. I didn't have any reaction at all, and using it made me feel clean and refreshed. I used it for several days before giving my opinion, and I recommend it 100% with its three acids and antioxidant-rich butterfly pea flower extract. This clinical formula expertly retexturizes, works on pores, and rmoisturizes skin as soft as a flower peral overnight. Patting it in helps the product work much better. I find the packaging very practical and easy to open. I liked its blue color and all the instructions and contents; it really worked for me and I liked it a lot.

I received this product in exchange for my honest review. My skin is generally on the dry side and I typically use moisturizing products to avoid my face feeling tight. This toner definitely made my skin feel smoother and did not dry out my face. I do feel a tingling sensation upon application but it's very temporary (a couple of seconds). It absorbed into my face quickly. I didn't see any significant/visible changes to my pores, but like I said, my skin is definitely smoother. I did have a couple of pimples during my first week of use but that's common for me when I first start using a new product. If you have a similar effect, I recommend starting this toner at a time when you don't have an important event. The scent is clean and not offensive and the bottle is a great value for the size and you need to use very little for the application.
